title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Compressible conservative state and perfect-gas formulation present.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured mesh and graph assembly source present.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual accumulation and global norms are implemented.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov exists, but Roe function returns Rusanov; contradicts report.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip, and no-slip branches present.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: implicit.cpp:195,206–231 disables reconstruction for all viscous and transient cases despite report claim; inviscid steady reconstruction exists.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth–Jespersen code exists for steady inviscid reconstruction, but implicit.cpp:195 disables its use on viscous/transient face states.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Viscous path exists but results show nonphysical force behavior.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS/Jacobi pseudo-time source present but stability is limited.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2-style source exists; transient.cpp:102–103,122–148 measures spatial residual against first physical step rather than per-step total inner residual; submitted force history is constant, metadata periodic and strict misses unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Genuine METIS and neighbor exchange/reductions exist, but full mesh is stored on all ranks during iterations, and selected short rank results do not demonstrate correct final outputs.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
